SHENGZHUSTS2MOD-TALISMAN_LOCATOR.title: Talisman Locator
SHENGZHUSTS2MOD-TALISMAN_LOCATOR.descrip:
Whenever you defeat an Elite and receive a relic, you can *forgo* that relic and gain a *random Talisman* relic you don't own.
After defeating a non-final *Boss*, gain an extra random Talisman relic you don't own. If you own them all, gain *+5 Max HP* instead.
SHENGZHUSTS2MOD-TALISMAN_LOCATOR.flavor: Use it to find the twelve talismans, and I will give you the Golden Rooster King's treasure... Valmont
SHENGZHUSTS2MOD-TWELVE_TALISMANS_COMPASS:
Whenever you can pick a relic, gain an extra Compass reward: choose *1* from up to *3* Talisman relics you do not own.
If fewer than *3* Talisman options can be offered, fill the remaining choices with *+5 Max HP*.
After defeating a non-final *Boss*, gain an extra Compass reward too.
*Right-click* to switch Talisman mode.
*1* Semi-auto mode (default)
*0* Manual mode
In semi-auto mode, Talismans automatically activate at the start of your turn and can still be manually canceled.
When all twelve Talismans align, the compass still points toward a stronger path.
SHENGZHUSTS2MOD-SHADOW_KHAN_TOKEN.title: Shadowkhan Token
SHENGZHUSTS2MOD-SHADOW_KHAN_TOKEN.descri:
ShengZhu-only relic.
*Right-click* to toggle Shadowkhan exhaust mode.
*1* manually choose a card to Exhaust (default)
*2* MingTa automatically Exhausts a card, YiKa Exhausts nothing
*0* automatically Exhaust a random valid card
SHENGZHUSTS2MOD-SHADOW_KHAN_TOKEN.flavor: The Shadowkhan follow orders. You decide how the order is given.
SHENGZHUSTS2MOD-RAT_TALISMAN.title: Rat Talisman
SHENGZHUSTS2MOD-RAT_TALISMAN.description:
*Right-click* to choose a *Status* or *Curse* card in hand, replace it with a random *Attack*, then enter *1* turn cooldown.
In semi-auto mode, checks and triggers automatically at the start of your turn.

While held, activates other Talismans' *Awakening Effect*.
When ShengZhu holds the Rat Talisman, combat starts in *True Form*. Use the form button to switch between *True Form* and *Statue Form*, limited to *1* switch each turn.
*True Form* benefits from the Rat Talisman and other Talismans' *Awakening Effects*; *Statue Form* has *Shendu Statue* and does not benefit from other Talisman awakenings granted by Rat Talisman.
SHENGZHUSTS2MOD-RAT_TALISMAN.flavor: Turning stillness into motion, granting life to the lifeless.
SHENGZHUSTS2MOD-RAT_TALISMAN.selectionSc: Choose a Curse or Status card to transform
SHENGZHUSTS2MOD-RAT_TALISMAN.formTooltip: Current: True Form. Benefits from Rat Talisman and other Talisman awakenings. Click to switch to Statue Form. Once per turn.
Current: Statue Form. Has Shendu Statue and does not benefit from other Talisman awakenings granted by Rat Talisman. Click to switch back to True Form. Once per turn.
Current: True Form. You already switched forms this turn. You can switch again next turn.
Current: Statue Form. You already switched forms this turn. You can switch again next turn.
SHENGZHUSTS2MOD-OX_TALISMAN.title: Ox Talisman
SHENGZHUSTS2MOD-OX_TALISMAN.description: *Right-click* to activate. Your next *Attack* deals double damage, then enters *2* turn cooldown. Right-click again to cancel.
SHENGZHUSTS2MOD-OX_TALISMAN.description_:
*Right-click* to activate. Your next *Attack* deals double damage, then enters *2* turn cooldown. Right-click again to cancel.

*Awakening Effect* When activation is consumed, gain *1* *Strength*.
SHENGZHUSTS2MOD-OX_TALISMAN.flavor: The mighty ox grants us immense strength.
SHENGZHUSTS2MOD-TIGER_TALISMAN.title: Tiger Talisman
SHENGZHUSTS2MOD-TIGER_TALISMAN.descripti:
When you *alternate* playing *Attack* and *Skill* cards, draw *1* card. Up to *3* times per turn.
*Strength* and *Dexterity* use the higher of the two values.

When you *alternate* playing *Attack* and *Skill* cards, draw *1* card. Up to *3* times per turn.
*Strength* and *Dexterity* use the higher of the two values.

*Awakening Effect* At end of turn, if Attacks played equals Skills played (and >0), draw *2* extra cards next turn.
SHENGZHUSTS2MOD-TIGER_TALISMAN.flavor: The power of balance, granting yin-yang harmony.
SHENGZHUSTS2MOD-RABBIT_TALISMAN.title: Rabbit Talisman
SHENGZHUSTS2MOD-RABBIT_TALISMAN.descript:
*Right-click* to activate. The next card you play that costs Energy refunds that Energy, then enters *1* turn cooldown.
Or right-click a cooling down Talisman to end its cooldown; Rabbit Talisman enters *2* turn cooldown.
Right-click again to cancel.

*Right-click* to activate. The next card you play that costs Energy refunds that Energy, then enters *1* turn cooldown.
Or right-click a cooling down Talisman to end its cooldown; Rabbit Talisman enters *2* turn cooldown.
Right-click again to cancel.

*Awakening Effect* Gain *1* Energy at the start of each turn.
SHENGZHUSTS2MOD-RABBIT_TALISMAN.flavor: The agile rabbit grants us the power to reverse time and space.
SHENGZHUSTS2MOD-DRAGON_TALISMAN.title: Dragon Talisman
SHENGZHUSTS2MOD-DRAGON_TALISMAN.descript: Every *10* cards played, deal *15* damage to ALL enemies.

Every *10* cards played, deal *15* damage to ALL enemies.

*Awakening Effect* Damage is increased by your current *Strength*.
SHENGZHUSTS2MOD-DRAGON_TALISMAN.flavor: The sacred dragon grants us the power to overcome all obstacles.
SHENGZHUSTS2MOD-SNAKE_TALISMAN.title: Snake Talisman
SHENGZHUSTS2MOD-SNAKE_TALISMAN.descripti: *Right-click* to activate. At the end of your turn, gain *1* *Intangible*, then enters *8* turn cooldown. Right-click again to cancel.

*Right-click* to activate. At the end of your turn, gain *1* *Intangible*, then enters *6* turn cooldown. Right-click again to cancel.

*Awakening Effect* Cooldown reduced from *8* to *6* turns.
SHENGZHUSTS2MOD-SNAKE_TALISMAN.flavor: The snake biting its tail signifies the cycle of life.
SHENGZHUSTS2MOD-HORSE_TALISMAN.title: Horse Talisman
SHENGZHUSTS2MOD-HORSE_TALISMAN.descripti:
*Right-click* to choose and remove *1* debuff, then enter *2* turn cooldown.
At combat end, heal *20%* of max HP. Each debuff successfully removed this combat lowers that healing by *5%*, to a minimum of *5%*.

*Right-click* to choose and remove *1* debuff, then enter *2* turn cooldown.
At combat end, heal *30%* of max HP. Each debuff successfully removed this combat lowers that healing by *5%*, to a minimum of *5%*.

*Awakening Effect* Base post-combat healing increased from *20%* to *30%*.
SHENGZHUSTS2MOD-HORSE_TALISMAN.flavor: The noble horse purges all foreign forces from within.
SHENGZHUSTS2MOD-SHEEP_TALISMAN.title: Sheep Talisman
SHENGZHUSTS2MOD-SHEEP_TALISMAN.descripti: *Right-click* to activate. Your next debuff applied to an enemy has its stacks *doubled*, then enters *2* turn cooldown. Right-click again to cancel.

*Right-click* to activate. Your next debuff applied to an enemy has its stacks *doubled*, then enters *2* turn cooldown. Right-click again to cancel.

*Awakening Effect* At the start of the first combat turn, Upgrade all cards in your opening hand.
SHENGZHUSTS2MOD-SHEEP_TALISMAN.flavor: The soul is silent, formless, and shadowless.
SHENGZHUSTS2MOD-MONKEY_TALISMAN.title: Monkey Talisman
SHENGZHUSTS2MOD-MONKEY_TALISMAN.descript:
Provides a *72 Transformations* option at Rest Sites: choose a card from your deck to transform. Self-only. Limited to *3* uses.
After a successful Rest Site transformation, heal *20%* of max HP.

Provides a *72 Transformations* option at Rest Sites: choose a card from your deck to transform. Self-only. Limited to *3* uses.
After a successful Rest Site transformation, heal *20%* of max HP.

*Awakening Effect* In combat, *right-click* to use 72 Transformations once: self-only, choose a card in hand to transform into any card from your class pool.
SHENGZHUSTS2MOD-MONKEY_TALISMAN.searchPl: Search card name, description, or keyword
SHENGZHUSTS2MOD-MONKEY_TALISMAN.flavor: The clever monkey grants us the power to transform all things.
SHENGZHUSTS2MOD-MONKEY_TALISMAN.combatSe: [72 Transformations] Choose one of your cards to transform
SHENGZHUSTS2MOD-ROOSTER_TALISMAN.title: Rooster Talisman
SHENGZHUSTS2MOD-ROOSTER_TALISMAN.descrip: *Levitation*: When selecting map nodes, you can ignore path restrictions and travel to any room on the next floor. *10* uses total.

*Levitation*: When selecting map nodes, you can ignore path restrictions and travel to any room on the next floor. *10* uses total.

*Awakening Effect* At end of turn, choose cards from your hand to Retain until next turn.
SHENGZHUSTS2MOD-ROOSTER_TALISMAN.flavor: The proud rooster grants us the ability to soar through the sky.
SHENGZHUSTS2MOD-ROOSTER_TALISMAN.retainP: Choose cards to retain until next turn
SHENGZHUSTS2MOD-DOG_TALISMAN.title: Dog Talisman
SHENGZHUSTS2MOD-DOG_TALISMAN.description:
Once per combat: upon receiving fatal damage, HP is preserved at *25%* instead of dying, and you gain *999* *Block*.
If this effect was not used this combat, gain *1* Max HP after winning combat.

Once per combat: upon receiving fatal damage, HP is preserved at *35%* instead of dying, and you gain *999* *Block*.
If this effect was not used this combat, gain *1* Max HP after winning combat.

*Awakening Effect* HP preserved at *35%* instead of *25%*.
SHENGZHUSTS2MOD-DOG_TALISMAN.flavor: The loyal dog grants us the power of immortality.
SHENGZHUSTS2MOD-PIG_TALISMAN.title: Pig Talisman
SHENGZHUSTS2MOD-PIG_TALISMAN.description: *Right-click* to activate. Your next *Attack* removes enemy *Block* before dealing damage, then enters *3* turn cooldown. Right-click again to cancel.

*Right-click* to activate. Your next *Attack* removes enemy *Block* before dealing damage, then enters *3* turn cooldown. Right-click again to cancel.

*Awakening Effect* When playing a single-target Attack, deal *15%* splash damage to adjacent enemies.
SHENGZHUSTS2MOD-PIG_TALISMAN.flavor: Wow! My eyes can shoot lasers! So cool!
SHENGZHUSTS2MOD-SHIVA_BRACELET.title: Bracelets of Shiva
SHENGZHUSTS2MOD-SHIVA_BRACELET.descripti: At the start of each turn, your first two *Attack* cards are *replayed* *1* time.
SHENGZHUSTS2MOD-SHIVA_BRACELET.flavor: Divine strength circles through gold, promising one more strike after the first.
SHENGZHUSTS2MOD-COLLABORATION_RELIC.desc:
Combat card rewards contain 1 additional card. That extra card is a random *Team Jackie* card.
Without this relic, *Team Jackie* cards do not appear naturally.
SHENGZHUSTS2MOD-COLLABORATION_RELIC.flav: This time, light and shadow sit at the same table.
SHENGZHUSTS2MOD-PAN_KU_BOX.title: Pan Ku Box
SHENGZHUSTS2MOD-PAN_KU_BOX.description: Mark nodes on the map for each missing *Demon* card. Elites marked by a *Demon Gate* gain extra HP and Strength. After winning at a marked node, choose one reward from *Demon Card* / *Immediate Enchant* / *Store Demon Qi*. Stored Demon Qi can be enchanted at a *Rest Site* by spending the rest action.
SHENGZHUSTS2MOD-PAN_KU_BOX.description_s:
Mark nodes on the map for each missing *Demon* card. Elites marked by a *Demon Gate* gain extra HP and Strength. After winning at a marked node, choose one reward from *Demon Card* / *Immediate Enchant* / *Store Demon Qi*. Stored Demon Qi can be enchanted at a *Rest Site* by spending the rest action.

Stored Qi: *{StoredQi}*
SHENGZHUSTS2MOD-PAN_KU_BOX.flavor: Everything has two sides: yin and yang, light and shadow. Only perfect balance opens the gate.
SHENGZHUSTS2MOD-PAN_KU_BOX.rewardChoice: Pan Ku Box: choose a *{Qi}* Demon Qi reward.
SHENGZHUSTS2MOD-PAN_KU_BOX.rewardEnchant: Immediately enchant a card with *{Qi}* Demon Qi.
SHENGZHUSTS2MOD-PAN_KU_BOX.rewardStore: Store *{Qi}* Demon Qi in the Pan Ku Box.
SHENGZHUSTS2MOD-PAN_KU_BOX.choicePrompt: Pan Ku Box: choose this Demon Qi reward.
SHENGZHUSTS2MOD-PAN_KU_BOX.enchantPrompt: Choose a card to enchant. Valid targets: {EnchantTargetType}.
SHENGZHUSTS2MOD-HISTORY_BOOK_FRAGMENT.de:
*Right-click* to choose a *rewrite reality* option based on the current scene. In combat, rewrite enemy HP, stun, draw/energy, or piles; at Rest Sites, keep remaining options available; in Shops, enable free purchases or restocking.
Starts with *12* uses. Remaining uses are shown on the relic counter.
SHENGZHUSTS2MOD-HISTORY_BOOK_FRAGMENT.fl: A torn page is still history, just with sharper edges.
SHENGZHUSTS2MOD-HISTORY_BOOK_FRAGMENT.ch: Choose a reality to rewrite. Canceling spends no uses.
SHENGZHUSTS2MOD-LIFE_CHALICE.title: Chalice of Life
SHENGZHUSTS2MOD-LIFE_CHALICE.description: Gain *3* Potion slots. Whenever you successfully use a non-automatic Potion, replay its effect *1* time and heal for *10%* of your Max HP. Overflow healing becomes Max HP.
SHENGZHUSTS2MOD-LIFE_CHALICE.flavor: The ancient golden cup seemed to hold life itself within it.
